The two-pass (halo + color) line/circle/rect/poly primitives, hud.js:62-97,111-122 (_line/_circle/_rect/_poly), consolidated into one shared class so HudView and the reimplemented Map views draw through the same primitives -- the JS never shared these across hud.js/mapui.js either (each drew into its own 2D context), so this is a deliberate consolidation, not a transliteration. hud.js:99-109 _text(). Canvas2D's fillText/strokeText has no UI Toolkit equivalent (Painter2D draws vectors only); this pools reusable Label children instead of allocating a new one per mark per frame, which in C# (unlike a scratch Vector3) is a real GC/layout cost. Used by HudView, MiniMapView and BigMapView alike.
